investigation_notes: Reliability incident investigation of a production environment. Evidence consists of Elasticsearch aggregation results over application and proxy logs, Kubernetes, cloud-provider and host system events, Prometheus Alertmanager alerts, change-management / CI-CD audit records and metric anomaly detection. No root cause, impact or trigger is stated; these must be established from the supplied artifacts. Environment context: Organization: Corvid Health (clinic scheduling SaaS); Platform: AWS ap-south-1 (zones ap-south-1a/1b/1c); Kubernetes cluster: corvid-prod-aps1 (EKS, node range 10.81.0.0/16); Identity: identity-svc issues and introspects OAuth tokens for all internal callers and is backed by PostgreSQL identity-db; Deployments: Spinnaker pipelines with CHG- identifiers, including any bundled database migrations.
